company.name: Orthogonal
company.shortDescription: Orthogonal is advancing the field of display manufacturing by lifting the constraints of traditional photolithography.
company.description: Orthogonal is advancing the field of display manufacturing by lifting the constraints of traditional photolithography. Orthogonal’s proprietary photoresist solution allows the direct patterning of a wide range of organic electronic materials for high resolution AMOLED and flexible display applications.

productsAndServices.description: A photoresist system compatible with organic materials enabling high-resolution patterning for OLED and organic electronic manufacturing.
productsAndServices.name: OSCoR Photoresist System

productsAndServices.description: A manufacturing approach using photolithography to produce ultra-high resolution OLED displays for virtual reality applications, surpassing traditional fine metal mask methods.
productsAndServices.name: High Resolution OLED (VR) Manufacturing Solution

productsAndServices.description: A photolithography-based manufacturing process for mobile OLED displays that improves yield, throughput, and scalability compared to fine metal mask methods.
productsAndServices.name: Mobile OLED Manufacturing Solution

productsAndServices.description: A photolithographic patterning technology for organic photodetectors used in under-display fingerprint sensors with high resolution and sensitivity.
productsAndServices.name: Organic Photodetector Patterning for Under-Display Fingerprint Sensors

productsAndServices.description: An AI-native cloud platform for end-to-end hardware design, simulation, and manufacturing using natural language prompts.
productsAndServices.name: ODE (Orthogonal Design Engineering)

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Angel round raised $2,130,000, or 75.37% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $695,951, representing 24.63% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $12,909,845 to $12,909,845, a 1x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
